name: Takahashi
source: One of the characters of the Correctness storyline. A high school girl working as a courier. She is often hired by Hirooka, the coroner, to deliver items to Heinous Crimes Unit detectives working in the field. Has an ability to quickly recognize locations by the flow of the air as long as the location in question is in her territory.
